# AteBit Tech — Retro & Vintage Computing Database
> Hand-curated directory of 763 retro and vintage computing resources — repair services, hardware vendors, YouTube channels, community forums, and more. Amiga to ZX Spectrum and beyond.

## Core Pages
- [Home / Directory](https://atebit.tech/): searchable, filterable directory of all 763 entries
- [Price Guide](https://atebit.tech/store/): search eBay sold listings, compare prices
- [Classic Version](https://atebit.tech/classic/): plain HTML, works on vintage browsers
- [About](https://atebit.tech/about.html): project background and contact
- [Privacy](https://atebit.tech/privacy.html): no cookies, no stored IP addresses, no personal data; GoatCounter records page views and country only. Price Guide links are eBay Partner Network affiliate links
- [Newsletter](https://atebittech.substack.com): Substack updates
